calculation.description: Uses only the previous completed day's close. Assets near the bottom of their trailing 90-session range receive higher scores, with scores scaled by inverse lagged 40-session realized volatility. Ties and zero ranges are treated as missing.

metrics.icir_convention: daily IC mean divided by daily IC standard deviation, consistent with benchmark admission reporting

validation.regime_notes: Positive over the full available history and recent 260/520/780-session windows; 10-day ICs were 0.107133, 0.056643, and 0.057928 respectively. Small cross-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
